items.title: Ellen Rowe interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 2, 2024
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Less dramatic perhaps. But so you’re going to write about Michelle Obama... [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah. I think, in that piece I was just thinking about the aspects of her that I most admired...

ctx.x: Yeah. So I will say that is one of the most overt attempts that I’ve ever made in any kind of music so yeah it was one of those things where I was really struggling to think how — because I don’t normally do this. I thought you know wouldn’t it be fun to see if I could. I played tennis all through high school and tried to play in college until I realized that Eastman School of Music did not have a tennis team and they did not want me running over to the University of Rochester. So you know I knew a lot about it…

Less dramatic perhaps. But so you’re going to write about Michelle Obama, do you have a process that before you even touch a keyboard or however you — do you think about the subject first and maybe come up with adjectives or themes to guide you?
Yeah. I think, in that piece I was just thinking about the aspects of her that I most admired and you know I don’t know that I’m consciously trying to go, you know, trying © Fillius Jazz Archive -6-
